Title: انگلیسی را قورت بده - جلد چهارم
Subtitle: مکالمات پیشرفته و داستان‌های بلندتر در ۱۰ درس
Description: دوره چهارم آموزش انگلیسی - زمان‌های گذشته و آینده، مکالمات تلفنی، داستان‌های بلندتر
Author: Hayt Academy

Sections.Title: بخش اول: زمان‌ها و مکالمات پیشرفته

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۱: زمان گذشته ساده - کارهایی که دیروز انجام دادم
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

الکس درباره دیروزش می‌گه:

"Yesterday was a busy day. I woke up at 7 o'clock. I ate breakfast and went to work. I worked until 5 o'clock. Then I came home and watched TV."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Yesterday = دیروز
- Last night = دیشب
- Ago = پیش
- Woke up = بیدار شدم
- Ate = خوردم
- Went = رفتم
- Came = آمدم
- Watched = تماشا کردم
- Worked = کار کردم
- Played = بازی کردم
- Visited = دیدار کردم
- Cooked = آشپزی کردم

📝 گرامر: گذشته ساده
برای ساختن گذشته ساده، به فعل `-ed` اضافه می‌کنیم:
- Play → Played
- Work → Worked
- Watch → Watched

بعضی فعل‌ها بی‌قاعده هستند:
- Go → Went
- Eat → Ate
- Come → Came
- Wake up → Woke up

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- Yesterday, I went to the park = دیروز به پارک رفتم
- I ate pizza for dinner = برای شام پیتزا خوردم
- She visited her grandmother = او مادربزرگش را دیدار کرد
- We played football yesterday = دیروز فوتبال بازی کردیم

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه:
A: "What did you do yesterday?"
B: "I went to work and then came home."
A: "Did you watch TV?"
B: "Yes, I watched a movie."

🔁 مرور:
درس ۱۸: زمان و ساعت
درس ۹: اعداد
حالا ترکیب کن:
"Yesterday, I woke up at 7 o'clock."
"I went to work at 8 o'clock."

💡 نکته مادرانه:
درباره دیروزت بگو:
"Yesterday, I ..."

Questions.Explanation: گذشته Go = Went (بی‌قاعده)

Questions.OptionB: Yesterday I went to the park
Questions.OptionC: Tomorrow I will go to park
Questions.Explanation: Yesterday I went to the park = دیروز به پارک رفتم

Questions.OptionB: جمع‌بندی جلد سوم و سطح A2
Questions.Explanation: درس ۳۰ جمع‌بندی جلد سوم بود

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۲: زمان آینده - برنامه‌های فردا
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

سارا درباره برنامه‌های فرداش می‌گه:

"Tomorrow is Friday. I will wake up late. I will have breakfast with my family. Then I will go to the cinema with Alex. We will watch a new movie."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Tomorrow = فردا
- Next week = هفته آینده
- Next month = ماه آینده
- Will = خواهم (برای آینده)
- Plan = برنامه
- Cinema = سینما
- Movie = فیلم
- Trip = سفر
- Meeting = جلسه
- Appointment = قرار ملاقات
- Invite = دعوت کردن
- Promise = قول دادن

📝 گرامر: آینده با Will
فاعل + will + فعل ساده
- I will go = من خواهم رفت
- She will come = او خواهد آمد
- We will eat = ما خواهیم خورد

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- I will go to the cinema tomorrow = فردا به سینما خواهم رفت
- She will visit us next week = او هفته آینده به دیدن ما خواهد آمد
- We will have a meeting at 3 o'clock = ساعت ۳ جلسه خواهیم داشت
- I will call you tonight = امشب بهت زنگ می‌زنم

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه:
A: "What will you do tomorrow?"
B: "I will visit my grandmother."
A: "That's nice! What time will you go?"
B: "I will go at 10 o'clock in the morning."

🔁 مرور:
درس ۳۱: گذشته
درس ۱۸: زمان
حالا ترکیب کن:
"Yesterday I went to work. Tomorrow I will go to the park."

💡 نکته مادرانه:
درباره برنامه‌های فردات بگو:
"Tomorrow I will ..."

Questions.QuestionText: برای آینده از چه کلمه‌ای استفاده می‌کنیم؟
Questions.Explanation: Will برای آینده استفاده می‌شود

Questions.QuestionText: چطور بگی «فردا به سینما خواهم رفت»؟
Questions.OptionB: Tomorrow I will go to the cinema
Questions.Explanation: Tomorrow I will go to the cinema = فردا به سینما خواهم رفت
در درس ۳۱ زمان گذشته ساده را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۳: مکالمه تلفنی
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

سارا به الکس زنگ می‌زنه:

"Hello?"
"Hi Alex! This is Sara."
"Oh, hi Sara! How are you?"
"I'm good. I'm calling to invite you to my party."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Call = زنگ زدن
- Phone = تلفن
- Ring = زنگ خوردن
- Answer = جواب دادن
- Message = پیام
- Voicemail = پیغام گیر
- Busy = مشغول
- Available = در دسترس
- Call back = دوباره زنگ زدن
- Hang up = قطع کردن
- Hold on = صبر کن
- Wrong number = شماره اشتباه

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- Hello, this is Sara = الو، سارا هستم
- Can I speak to Alex? = می‌توانم با الکس صحبت کنم؟
- Hold on, please = لطفاً صبر کنید
- I will call you back = بعداً بهت زنگ می‌زنم
- Sorry, wrong number = ببخشید، شماره اشتباه

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه تلفنی:
Sara: "Hello?"
Alex: "Hi Sara! This is Alex."
Sara: "Hi Alex! How are you?"
Alex: "I'm fine. I'm calling to ask about the homework."
Sara: "Sure! Hold on, let me get my notebook."
Alex: "Thanks!"

🔁 مرور:
درس ۳۱: گذشته
درس ۳۲: آینده
حالا ترکیب کن:
"I called you yesterday."
"I will call you tomorrow."

💡 نکته مادرانه:
تمرین کن تلفنی به انگلیسی جواب بدی:
"Hello? This is ..."

Questions.Explanation: توی تلفن می‌گوییم This is ...
Hold on یعنی صبر کن / منتظر باش
در درس ۳۲ زمان آینده را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۴: درخواست مؤدبانه و کمک خواستن
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

الکس توی خیابون گم شده:

"Excuse me, could you help me please?"
"Of course! How can I help you?"
"Could you tell me how to get to the museum?"
"Sure! Go straight and turn left. It's on your right."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Could you...? = می‌توانی...؟ (مؤدبانه)
- Would you...? = می‌خواهی...؟ (مؤدبانه)
- May I...? = می‌توانم...؟ (خیلی مؤدبانه)
- Please = لطفاً
- Thank you = متشکرم
- Thanks a lot = خیلی ممنون
- You're welcome = خواهش می‌کنم
- Sure = حتماً
- Of course = البته
- No problem = مشکلی نیست

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- Could you help me, please? = می‌توانی به من کمک کنی لطفاً؟
- Would you like some tea? = چای می‌خواهی؟
- May I come in? = می‌توانم وارد شوم؟
- Could you repeat that, please? = می‌توانی آن را تکرار کنی لطفاً؟
- Could you speak slower, please? = می‌توانی آرام‌تر صحبت کنی لطفاً؟

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه:
A: "Excuse me, could you help me?"
B: "Of course!"
A: "Could you tell me where the bank is?"
B: "Sure! It's next to the supermarket."
A: "Thank you so much!"
B: "You're welcome!"

🔁 مرور:
درس ۱۷: جهت‌ها
درس ۶: Where
حالا ترکیب کن:
"Could you tell me where the hospital is?"

💡 نکته مادرانه:
همیشه مؤدبانه صحبت کن:
"Could you please ...?"
"Thank you!"

Questions.Explanation: May I... مؤدبانه‌ترین شکل درخواست است

Questions.QuestionText: Could you repeat that? یعنی چه؟
Questions.Explanation: Could you repeat that? یعنی می‌توانی آن را تکرار کنی؟
در درس ۳۳ مکالمه تلفنی را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۵: احساسات و حالات
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

سارا امروز حال خوبی نداره:

"What's wrong, Sara? You look sad."
"I'm feeling a little tired and stressed."
"Oh, I'm sorry. Is there anything I can do?"
"Thanks, Alex. Just talking to you helps."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Happy = خوشحال
- Sad = غمگین
- Angry = عصبانی
- Scared = ترسیده
- Excited = هیجان‌زده
- Bored = خسته / حوصله‌ام سر رفته
- Tired = خسته (از نظر جسمی)
- Stressed = استرس‌دار
- Relaxed = آرام
- Worried = نگران
- Surprised = متعجب
- Proud = مفتخر

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- I feel happy today = امروز احساس خوشحالی می‌کنم
- She looks sad = او غمگین به نظر می‌رسد
- Why are you angry? = چرا عصبانی هستی؟
- I'm excited about the trip = از سفر هیجان‌زده هستم
- Don't worry! = نگران نباش!

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه:
A: "How are you feeling today?"
B: "I feel a little tired."
A: "Why don't you rest?"
B: "Good idea! I will take a nap."

🔁 مرور:
درس ۸: I am = من هستم
درس ۲۲: شخصیت
حالا ترکیب کن:
"I am happy because it's a sunny day."
"She is sad because she lost her phone."

💡 نکته مادرانه:
هر روز درباره احساساتت بگو:
"Today I feel ..."

Questions.Explanation: Excited یعنی هیجان‌زده
Don't worry = نگران نباش
در درس ۳۴ درخواست مؤدبانه را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۶: مقایسه کردن
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

سارا و الکس درباره شهرها مقایسه می‌کنند:

"Tehran is bigger than Isfahan."
"Really? But Isfahan is more beautiful than Tehran!"
"You're right! And the weather in Isfahan is better."

🎯 کلمات جدید:
- Bigger = بزرگ‌تر
- Smaller = کوچک‌تر
- Taller = بلندتر
- Shorter = کوتاه‌تر
- Faster = سریع‌تر
- Slower = آرام‌تر
- Better = بهتر
- Worse = بدتر
- More beautiful = زیباتر
- More expensive = گران‌تر
- Cheaper = ارزان‌تر
- Than = از (برای مقایسه)

📝 گرامر: صفات مقایسه‌ای
برای صفات کوتاه (یک یا دو سیلابی): صفت + er
- Big → Bigger
- Tall → Taller
- Fast → Faster

برای صفات بلند: more + صفت
- Beautiful → More beautiful
- Expensive → More expensive

بی‌قاعده:
- Good → Better
- Bad → Worse

📝 جملات کاربردی:
- My car is faster than your car = ماشین من از ماشین تو سریع‌تر است
- She is taller than me = او از من بلندتر است
- This book is more interesting = این کتاب جالب‌تر است
- Summer is better than winter = تابستان از زمستان بهتر است

🗣️ تمرین مکالمه:
A: "Which city is bigger, Tehran or Isfahan?"
B: "Tehran is bigger than Isfahan."
A: "Which season is better, spring or summer?"
B: "I think spring is better."

🔁 مرور:
درس ۲۱: توصیف
درس ۲۴: شهرها
حالا ترکیب کن:
"Tehran is bigger than my village."
"Spring is more beautiful than winter."

💡 نکته مادرانه:
درباره چیزهای مختلف مقایسه کن:
"... is bigger than ..."
"... is better than ..."

Questions.Explanation: Big → Bigger (بزرگ‌تر)
Better مقایسه Good (خوب → بهتر) است
در درس ۳۵ احساسات و حالات را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۷: داستان بلند - سفر به شمال
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

یک داستان بلندتر! 🎉

🎯 داستان:

"Last summer, Sara and her family went on a trip to the north of Iran. They went to a beautiful village near the Caspian Sea.

The weather was warm and sunny. The sky was blue and the sea was very beautiful. They stayed in a small hotel near the beach.

Every morning, Sara woke up early. She went for a walk on the beach. She collected seashells and watched the waves. The sound of the waves was relaxing.

In the afternoon, they went swimming in the sea. The water was cool and clean. Sara's father caught a fish! They cooked the fish for dinner. It was delicious!

One day, they visited a forest near the village. The forest was full of tall green trees. They saw many birds and heard their songs. Sara took many photos.

On the last day, Sara felt sad. She didn't want to go home. She loved the village, the sea, and the forest.

'Can we come here again next year?' Sara asked her mother.
'Of course, my dear! We will come again next summer,' her mother said.

Sara was happy. She said goodbye to the sea and promised to come back."

📝 کلمات جدید داستان:
- Trip = سفر
- Sea = دریا
- Beach = ساحل
- Wave = موج
- Collect = جمع کردن
- Seashell = صدف دریایی
- Swim = شنا کردن
- Catch = گرفتن
- Forest = جنگل
- Bird = پرنده
- Song = آواز
- Photo = عکس
- Promise = قول دادن

🗣️ تمرین:
داستان را بخوان و به این سوالات جواب بده:
1. سارا کجا رفت؟
2. هر روز صبح چه کار می‌کرد؟
3. چه حیواناتی در جنگل دید؟

🔁 مرور:
درس ۳۱: گذشته (went, stayed, woke up, caught)
درس ۳۲: آینده (will come)

💡 نکته مادرانه:
حالا می‌تونی یه داستان بلند رو بخونی و بفهمی! 🎉

Questions.OptionB: به شمال ایران نزدیک دریای خزر
Questions.Explanation: سارا به شمال ایران نزدیک دریای خزر رفت

Questions.QuestionText: سارا هر روز صبح چه کار می‌کرد؟
Questions.Explanation: هر روز صبح کنار ساحل قدم می‌زد و صدف جمع می‌کرد
در درس ۳۶ مقایسه کردن را یاد گرفتیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۸: داستان بلند - اولین روز مدرسه
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

دومین داستان بلند!

🎯 داستان:

"Yesterday was Alex's first day at a new school. He was nervous and excited at the same time.

He woke up at 6:30 in the morning. He put on his new blue shirt and black pants. He ate a quick breakfast and went to school.

The school was big and modern. There were many students in the yard. Alex didn't know anyone. He felt a little scared.

A friendly girl came to him. 'Hi! Are you new here?' she asked.
'Yes, I am. My name is Alex,' he said.
'I'm Mary. Nice to meet you! Come with me. I will show you around.'

Mary showed Alex the classrooms, the library, and the cafeteria. The library was big and quiet. The cafeteria was clean and had good food.

In the first class, the teacher said, 'Welcome, Alex! Please sit next to Mary.'

During the break, Alex played football with some new friends. He was happy because everyone was friendly.

At the end of the day, Mary said, 'Did you like your first day?'
'Yes! It was great! Thank you for your help,' Alex said.
'No problem! See you tomorrow!' Mary said.

Alex went home with a big smile. He was no longer nervous. He was excited for the next day."

📝 کلمات جدید داستان:
- First day = اولین روز
- Nervous = مضطرب
- Put on = پوشید
- Quick = سریع
- Yard = حیاط
- Show around = گردش دادن
- Classroom = کلاس درس
- Library = کتابخانه
- Cafeteria = کافه‌تریا / غذاخوری
- During = در طول
- Break = زنگ تفریح
- End = پایان
- Smile = لبخند
- No longer = دیگر نه

🗣️ تمرین:
داستان را بخوان و بگو:
1. الکس چه احساسی داشت؟
2. چه کسی به الکس کمک کرد؟
3. آخر روز الکس چه احساسی داشت؟

🔁 مرور:
درس ۳۱: گذشته (was, went, put on, ate, said)
درس ۳۵: احساسات (nervous, excited, scared, happy)

💡 نکته مادرانه:
درباره اولین روز مدرسه‌ات بگو:
"My first day was ... I felt ..."

Questions.QuestionText: الکس در اولین روز مدرسه چه احساسی داشت؟
Questions.Explanation: الکس هم نگران (nervous) و هم هیجان‌زده (excited) بود

Questions.QuestionText: چه کسی به الکس کمک کرد؟
Questions.Explanation: مری (Mary) به الکس کمک کرد و مدرسه را نشان داد
در درس ۳۷ داستان سفر به شمال را خواندیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۳۹: داستان بلند - مهمانی شام
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

سومین داستان بلند!

🎯 داستان:

"Last Saturday, Sara's family had a dinner party. They invited Alex and his family.

Sara's mother cooked many delicious foods. She made chicken, rice, salad, and a big chocolate cake for dessert. The house smelled wonderful.

At 7 o'clock, the doorbell rang. Alex and his parents arrived. Alex was holding a bouquet of flowers for Sara's mother.

'These are for you, Mrs. Sara. Thank you for inviting us!' Alex said.
'Oh, thank you, Alex! They are beautiful! Please come in.'

Everyone sat at the table. The table was beautiful. There were candles and flowers on it.

'Everything looks delicious!' Alex's father said.
'Please help yourselves!' Sara's mother said.

During dinner, they talked about many things. Alex's father talked about his job. Sara's father talked about their trip to the north. Alex and Sara talked about school and their hobbies.

After dinner, they had tea and cake. Alex's mother said, 'The cake is amazing! Can I have the recipe?'
'Of course! I will write it for you,' Sara's mother said.

At 10 o'clock, Alex's family said goodbye.
'Thank you for a wonderful evening!' Alex's father said.
'You're welcome! We should do this again next month,' Sara's father said.

Sara was happy. She loved having guests at home. She went to bed with a smile."

📝 کلمات جدید داستان:
- Dinner party = مهمانی شام
- Invite = دعوت کردن
- Smell = بو دادن
- Wonderful = فوق‌العاده
- Doorbell = زنگ در
- Arrive = رسیدن
- Hold = در دست داشتن
- Candle = شمع
- Help yourselves = کمک بگیرید (خودتان بردارید)
- Recipe = دستور پخت
- Evening = عصر / شب
- Guest = مهمان

🗣️ تمرین:
داستان را بخوان و بگو:
1. مهمانی چه روزی بود؟
2. الکس چه هدیه‌ای آورد؟
3. بعد از شام چه خوردند؟

🔁 مرور:
درس ۳۱: گذشته (had, invited, cooked, made, said)
درس ۳۲: آینده (should do)

💡 نکته مادرانه:
درباره آخرین مهمانی‌ که رفتی بگو:
"Last ... I went to a party. We had ..."

Questions.QuestionText: الکس برای مادر سارا چه هدیه‌ای آورد؟
Questions.Explanation: الکس یک دسته گل (bouquet of flowers) آورد
بعد از شام چای و کیک خوردند
در درس ۳۸ داستان اولین روز مدرسه را خواندیم

Lessons.Title: درس ۴۰: جمع‌بندی جلد چهارم - سطح B1 🎉
Lessons.Content:
📖 داستان این درس:

تبریک! به آخر جلد چهارم رسیدی! 🎉

حالا در سطح **B1 (Intermediate)** هستی! یعنی:
- تافل: حدود **۴۰-۵۰**
- آیلتس: حدود **۴-۴.۵**

🎯 کارهایی که می‌تونی انجام بدی:
✅ از زمان گذشته برای گفتن کارهای دیروز استفاده کنی
✅ از زمان آینده برای برنامه‌های فردا بگی
✅ مکالمه تلفنی انجام بدی
✅ درخواست مؤدبانه بکنی
✅ درباره احساساتت صحبت کنی
✅ چیزها رو مقایسه کنی

🎯 مکالمه نهایی:

Sara: "Hi Alex! You look happy today!"
Alex: "Yes! I'm excited because I will go on a trip next week."
Sara: "Really? Where will you go?"
Alex: "I will go to the north with my family. We went there last year too. It was amazing!"
Sara: "That sounds great! The north is more beautiful than the city."
Alex: "Yes! Last time, I went swimming in the sea every day. The water was warm and clean."
Sara: "Did you take photos?"
Alex: "Yes! I took many photos. I will show you when I come back."
Sara: "Could you bring me a souvenir?"
Alex: "Of course! I will bring you something special."
Sara: "Thank you! I will miss you."
Alex: "I will miss you too! I will call you every night."
Sara: "Promise?"
Alex: "Promise!"
